text:
marta: Heads-up: starting a targeted admin entitlement cleanup for analytics-related roles next week. Owners will get a ping to justify or demote.

samir: thumbs-up. two asks: (1) can we exclude short-lived incident grants, and (2) confirm whether the audit logs contain a requestor field for KMS grants? we use that to map to ticket numbers.

owen: audit logs do have requestor but only for grants issued via the support flow. direct SDK grants are missing the requestor metadata — we should enrich them.

lee: created an issue: infra#2789 to propagate requestor and incident_id into grant metadata. also adding `auto_revert` bool and `revert_ts`.

access-bot: Reminder: entitlement pings scheduled 2026-04-06T15:00Z for channel owners. Automation window defaults to prune grants older than 7 days unless a PR updates `grace_days`.

marta: prefer 14 days for this run. we had some followups from last month's spike that still have open tickets.

samir: ok 14 days. i'll run a query to pull grants with `incident_id IS NOT NULL` and produce a whitelist.

owen: small nit: ensure that the review sheet includes `grant_origin` (support-lambda | sdk | console) so owners can see how it was created.

lee: good call. i'll add `grant_origin` to the grants export and tag grants with origin when we backfill.

marta: who will do the backfill? i can run a one-off job but need a safe script.

lee: i'll drop a shell snippet in infra/ops: 
```
#!/bin/bash
# backfill grant_origin from audit_events
psql -c "UPDATE kms_grants g SET grant_origin = e.origin FROM audit_events e WHERE e.grant_id = g.grant_id AND g.grant_origin IS NULL;"
```

samir: thanks. final ask: post-run, let's produce a short report: counts by origin, number demoted, exceptions whitelisted, and any gaps in audit metadata. i'll take that.

access-bot: Action queued: create whitelist from query results. To change grace_days to 14, open PR: infra/tools/admin-prune#update-grace-14d.

marta: perfect. i'll send owner reminder + calendar block. aim to have infra PR open by Tue and whitelist by Wed end of day.

owen: noted. if anyone notices strange grant churn during the run, mention me and i'll pause the automation.

samir: splitting follow-ups: (1) samir -> whitelist + post-run report, (2) lee -> infra#2789 and backfill script, (3) marta -> owner comms and calendar, (4) owen -> pause support if needed.

marta: thanks all. putting a checkpoint on Wed 10:00. :calendar:
